integrity: Mathematical proof is self-contained aside from standard finite-dimensional radical and idempotent-lifting facts; a standalone exact finite-field verifier checks specified finite cases and does not prove the infinite family. Prior literature could contain an equivalent characterization.
scientific_limitations: Finite-dimensional associative algebras with product-of-fields semisimple quotient; odd characteristic for exact count. Identifies only symmetrized total radical Peirce dimensions, not oriented quiver or multiplication. Published antecedents for involution counting are credited; no independent audit.
title: Unit–involution fibre counts reconstruct symmetrized radical Peirce graphs
